[![HAAS Alert](https://cdn.asp.events/CLIENT_Nineteen_F7A1E73F_5056_B725_6BE81DEAAC036B43/sites/ESS2025/media/libraries/exhibitors/5b987ed9-dfeb-11ef-95a-06bd0f937899-logo.jpg/fit-in/500x9999/filters:no_upscale())](https://www.haasalert.com/)

HAAS Alert is the creator of Safety Cloud®, a connected-vehicle digital alerting platform that gives drivers up to 30 seconds advance warning when an emergency vehicle is approaching or stopped on-scene. Alerts appear directly on in-dash vehicle screens and popular navigation apps, cutting through distraction and low visibility before drivers ever see flashing lights.
